records.title: ASI conservation, restoration, maintenance and development responsibility
records.description: Government of India confirmed that ASI undertakes conservation, restoration, maintenance and development works for monuments in Puri and Konark under the applicable conservation policy and AMASR framework.

records.title: Public amenities project at Sun Temple, Konark
records.description: National Culture Fund records a project for providing public amenities such as a smart toilet, childcare room and rest room for senior citizens at Sun Temple, Konark.

records.title: International Day of Yoga at Sun Temple, Konark
records.description: Sun Temple, Konark was included among the 81 centrally protected monuments where ASI hosted International Day of Yoga activities in collaboration with the Ministry of Ayush.

source.organization: Archaeological Survey of India / Ministry of Culture
source.title: ASI to Host 11th International Yoga Day Celebrations at 81 Historic Sites
